hero.title: Software & AI Engineer
hero.headline: Building AI systems that solve real-world problems.
hero.supporting: Applied AI · Machine Learning · Agentic Systems · Cloud & Full-Stack Engineering
hero.intro: I work across healthcare, education, accessibility, civic technology and machine learning. On every product I am both the full-stack and the AI engineer, from data and models to interface and deployment, with testing, privacy and accessibility built in from the start.

about.title: About
about.summary: I’m a software and AI engineer building practical systems for healthcare, education, accessibility and public participation. On my projects I work end to end as both the full-stack engineer and the AI engineer: data models, APIs, interfaces, testing and deployment, as well as model selection, prompt and agent design, evaluation and guardrails. My work combines LLM applications, machine learning, agentic workflows, web and mobile engineering, and cloud infrastructure, with close attention to data privacy and reliable deployment. I aim to make emerging technology useful to people and communities.
about.openTo: Open to software engineering, AI/ML and data roles, and to collaborations on human-centred AI.
about.background: Alongside engineering, I have a background in digital media: I was Digital Media Specialist at the Office of the Nairobi Woman Representative (2017–2024) and Media Specialist on contract with the Pan-African Parliament (2025). I trained through Power Learn Project (2024) and the ALX Data Science programme (2025–2026), and I am studying for a BSc in Computer Science at the University of the People.

highlights.title: Full-stack + AI, end to end
highlights.text: I build the whole product: database, APIs, interface and deployment, plus model choice, prompts, agents, evaluation and guardrails. AI Health Chat, TutaLearn, Sauti Mtaani Nairobi and Luminae are live.

highlights.title: Safety and privacy controls
highlights.text: Row Level Security, consent flows, PII scrubbing, budget caps and staff approval of AI suggestions.

highlights.title: Measured ML results
highlights.text: Hybrid SVD + LightGBM recommender on ~10M ratings: public-leaderboard RMSE 1.21 → 0.82.

highlights.title: Accessible and multilingual
highlights.text: EyeSense for blind and low-vision users; products in English and Kiswahili, and AI Health Chat in five languages.

highlights.title: Cloud and agents
highlights.text: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect; the five-agent Luminae and a seven-agent Vertex AI ADK capstone.

highlights.title: Recognition
highlights.text: 1st place at the Power Learn Project Class of 2024 graduate hackathon; President’s List and a 3.98 cumulative GPA at University of the People.
